_about: Background candidates from ChatGPT (2026-11-20), landscape 1920x1080, judged against the stage with kit/check_backdrop.py and sprite previews. Not wired into any build.

entries.notes: calm centre, cream wall and teal band make the boy pop, equipment small and to the sides. Floor is orange: legs melt into it (distance to skin 12). Change to cool grey/blue rubber.
calmest centre (1.3% busy), grey floor (51 from skin), dark teal wall makes cyan tank and skin pop. Round emblem sits behind his belly; cabinets cropped at the edges. Good for a later chart.

busiest behind him (12.9%): three big gridded windows, one right behind his head; orange brick fights the red shorts and skin. Floor is good. Keep only with blue-grey painted brick and the windows moved to the sides.
gold gears dwarf him; beige floor nearly the same as skin (22). Fun as a story level only after the floor is made stone grey and the gold toned down.
busy shelves both sides and an arch behind him; orange floor melts his legs (9). Better as a calm break-card background.

entries.verdict: DECISION 2026-11-20: gym is the base; floor lighter than charcoal
entries.notes: Author chose the charcoal-floor version of the gym (the file was not saved here). Weakest part of him on charcoal (74,79,90) is his black outline, 26 under deuteranopia; a mid grey around (112,118,128) scores 36 (weakest then his tank). The mock-up (recoloured from the orange gym) shows charcoal, lighter grey, and lighter grey with the kit's mat prop, which is a thin bar and does not read as a mat. A coloured mat adds no contrast: the best mat colours tie with the grey floor (about 37); choose it for looks. Next edit: floor to #707680 and a big perspective mat painted into the picture (muted teal #217678 with a darker edge).

entries.verdict: KEEPER (author, 2026-11-20): lighter grey floor, no mat baked in
entries.notes: The orange gym recoloured to a mid-grey rubber floor (about #707680). Remaining polish for a ChatGPT pass: plain centre window, no sunbeams in the middle third (prompts page: Gym keeper). The mat is a separate full-frame overlay in floor perspective (prop kind 'overlay'); see gym-keeper-mat-standin-preview.png for the intended look.
